RESULT [continual]: COCO 70+10 with Deformable DETR: 40.1 AP vs 36.9 for ERD, with joint training at about 44. COCO 40+40: 37.5 vs 36.0 for ERD.
US [continual]: This is the relevant recipe if RF-DETR, not YOLO, becomes the incremental learner. Its calibrated replay (keeping class frequencies the same as the full data) is a direct fix for harvest increments that are dominated by one or two species.
